title: Timothy Leary supplied LSD to JFK and Mary Meyer
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Timothy Leary supplied LSD to JFK and Mary Meyer, about 1960s at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And I provided by provided by Tim Liry.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer, says on a podcast that in the 1960s President John F. Kennedy and Mary Pinchot Meyer, a woman close to him in Washington, took LSD, a mind-altering drug, supplied by Timothy Leary, a psychologist famous for promoting it. Sheehan tells it as part of a wider account of Kennedy's private life and his interest in hidden matters, including UFOs.
